summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a 6-K with five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns (Sept 21-25, 2026) reporting on-market repurchases of WVR ordinary shares (HKEX 02390) earmarked for cancellation, each roughly 0.03-0.05% of issued shares, struck between USD 1.04 and USD 1.09 per share. Opening balance was 244,789,786 shares; no treasury shares were held. Mechanics follow HK Main Board Rule 13.25A disclosure, with repurchased shares awaiting cancellation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms were stated. Watch for cancellation timing, aggregate buyback pace, and any effect on liquidity and overhang.
